Message from you:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Message from TRX Virtual Assistant:
You can get started with setup and use here: Set-Up & Use. 
From there, the key basics are: 
Please make sure your suspension trainer is securely fastened, whether you are using it on an overhang beam, a pole, or a door.
Use the TRX Door Anchor included in your kit for at-home use:
Attach your Suspension Trainer to the Door Anchor and sling the Door Anchor over the top of your door.
Close the door (and lock if you can) and give the Suspension Trainer a light tug to pull the anchor taut.
Tip: Try to find doors that open away from the side you will be working out on. If you can’t, slide the Door Anchor closer to the door’s hinges to get more stability.
Use the yellow Suspension Anchor for outdoor use:
Wrap the Suspension Anchor around the sturdy object and clip the strap carabiner into one of the loops on the yellow strap.
Then, hook your Suspension Trainer to the open end of the yellow Suspension Anchor.
For best results and safety on the PRO system, it’s also important to use the included Locking Carabiner to keep your equipment secure and locked.
